description: Unsigned transactions taking everything a wallet is due on the same-day options desk after the close: for each of its series it settles the series first if nobody has, closes the wallet's lock (the collateral back less what the sold options are owed), claims what its option tokens pay (a call in the stock, a put in USDG), and takes anything the desk holds for it. Options that ended out of the money pay nothing and are left alone.

symbol.description: Only this stock (optional; default every stock with same-day options)

wallet.description: The wallet's address (0x...); the transactions are built for it to sign

name: collect_0dte
title: Prepare: collect same-day options after the close
